about:
# ImageOverlay
Add an image (animated or otherwise) that persists between scenes.

Nice for adding a custom watermark directly into your game, in case you're recording.

This [Geode mod](https://geode-sdk.org) is licensed under LGPLv2. To report bugs or get help with using my mods, press the Discord button in the lower left corner.
